security_audit.summary: The audit found many false positives from Markdown fences and JavaScript template literals, but the skill still contains real operational risk. Confirmed issues include shell command substitution, hidden artifact storage, filesystem writes, unpinned alpha CLI execution, GitHub publishing automation, and external sandbox uploads.

remediation.issue: Unpinned external CLI execution through npx claude-flow@alpha.
remediation.suggestion: Pin exact package versions, verify integrity, and require user approval before any npx, hook, memory, or sandbox command runs.

remediation.issue: Credentialed GitHub operations can mutate repository state and publish artifacts.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit confirmation gates before webhook changes, commits, pushes, PR creation, and status API calls. Replace git add . with an reviewed allowlist.

remediation.issue: Repository files and hidden artifacts can be uploaded to external sandbox tooling.
remediation.suggestion: Add secret scanning, artifact redaction, file allowlists, and dry-run mode before sandbox upload or memory storage.

remediation.issue: Hidden .claude artifacts may retain CI logs, patches, and analysis data.
remediation.suggestion: Document retention rules, avoid storing secrets, and clean generated artifacts after review.

remediation.issue: Shell command substitutions read local artifacts into prompts, commits, and PR bodies.
remediation.suggestion: Quote variables safely, validate artifact paths, redact sensitive values, and preview generated messages before execution.

content.user_title: Recover CI Failures With Evidence-Based Fixes
content.value_statement: Broken CI pipelines slow releases and hide root causes. This skill guides evidence-based failure analysis, repair planning, sandbox validation, and GitHub feedback.
actual_capabilities: Collects GitHub Actions failure logs through gh CLI examples.
Parses failure logs into structured .claude artifact files.
Coordinates multi-agent root cause, dependency, and test validity analysis.
Plans fixes with connascence context and validation checkpoints.
Runs sandbox, theater, and differential validation workflows.
Generates PR, status, and Loop 1 feedback report templates.
limitations: Requires authenticated GitHub CLI and local permission to run commands.
Assumes claude-flow alpha tooling is installed or available through npx.
Does not guarantee safe autonomous code changes without human review.
May expose repository data to external tools if prompts are run unchanged.

use_cases.title: Triage Failed GitHub Actions Runs
use_cases.description: Download failed workflow logs, parse failures, and prepare structured evidence for repair planning.

use_cases.title: Validate Test Repairs
use_cases.description: Check whether fixes address real defects, avoid shallow test theater, and pass sandbox validation.

use_cases.title: Close the Feedback Loop
use_cases.description: Summarize root causes, improvement metrics, and recurring failure patterns for future planning.

prompt_templates.title: Review Recent CI Failures
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review the latest failed GitHub Actions run. Summarize failing tests, likely causes, and required evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Root Cause Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the parsed CI failures. Separate primary root causes from cascaded failures. Include confidence levels and affected files.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Safe Repairs
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a minimal repair plan for each root cause. Include affected files, validation steps, side effects, and rollback guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Run Full Recovery Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Execute the complete recovery workflow with explicit approval before network calls, file writes, commits, pushes, or PR creation.

output_examples.input: A failed workflow contains unit test failures and one integration timeout.
output: Root cause summary with likely primary failures and cascaded failures.
Repair plan with affected files, validation checkpoints, and confidence notes.
Risk notes for external commands, repository writes, and GitHub updates.

output_examples.input: A fix passes locally but fails in sandbox validation.
output: Environment difference analysis with missing variables or service assumptions.
Recommended retry plan with sandbox configuration changes.
Decision on whether to revise the fix or escalate for review.

output_examples.input: A release manager needs a PR summary after automated repairs.
output: Plain-language summary of failures fixed and evidence collected.
Validation status for tests, theater checks, and differential analysis.
Follow-up lessons for the next planning loop.

best_practices: Review every shell, GitHub, and sandbox command before execution.
Pin external tools and verify package integrity before using npx workflows.
Redact secrets from logs and .claude artifacts before sharing reports.
anti_patterns: Do not run the full workflow with repository write access unattended.
Do not use git add . when artifacts may contain secrets or logs.
Do not treat a 100 percent test pass as proof of production safety.

faq.question: Does this skill automatically fix every CI failure?
faq.answer: No. It provides a workflow for analysis, repair planning, validation, and feedback. Human approval remains important.

faq.question: Which CI system does it target?
faq.answer: The examples focus on GitHub Actions and gh CLI commands.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require external services?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow references GitHub, claude-flow, Gemini-style analysis, and sandbox services.

faq.question: What data should I protect?
faq.answer: Protect CI logs, repository files, environment values, patches, and hidden .claude artifacts.

faq.question: Should I enable automatic publishing actions?
faq.answer: No. Require confirmation before commits, pushes, PR creation, webhook changes, or status updates.
